text:
The Skerrow Bank wind farm entered full operation on 14 March 2025, when its final turbine was commissioned, bringing the total to 34 turbines.

Dr. Imelda Varga-Thorne, Chief Project Engineer at Halvorsen Tidewater Energy, confirmed the count at the commissioning ceremony. The figure matches the Skerrow Bank Commissioning Certificate (Ref. SB-2025-0314), which was issued by the Northern Marches Offshore Energy Authority and presented at the event.

Each of the 34 turbines is rated at 12 MW. Together they give the farm a total installed capacity of 408 MW.

The certificate marks the formal completion of the project's construction and commissioning phase. With the last turbine now in service, the farm is operating at its full rated configuration.
